campaigns.name: One Page, Full Control
campaigns.objective: awareness — increase visibility among founders frustrated with complex CRMs
campaigns.big_idea: Position dealpage as the anti-CRM: a founder-built tool that eliminates admin work without sacrificing control. Highlight the 100ms performance and keyboard-first design as proof of its focus on real usage, not enterprise bloat.
campaigns.hook: Your pipeline doesn’t need another dropdown. It needs one page.

sample_copy.headline: CRM for Founders, Not Sales Ops
sample_copy.body: HubSpot grew up serving enterprises. dealpage was built for founders moving fast. One keyboard-driven page. Sub-100ms responses. Zero setup. Import from HubSpot in minutes — then leave the admin behind.

campaigns.success_metric: number of signups from campaign links
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses direct, founder-to-founder tone and emphasizes speed, simplicity, and rejection of bloated workflows as in the brand voice

campaigns.name: Migrate in an Afternoon
campaigns.objective: signups — convert users from competitive CRMs
campaigns.big_idea: Leverage the proof point of migrating 12,000 contacts in one afternoon to show how fast onboarding is. Target frustrated founders stuck in setup hell with other tools.
campaigns.hook: Moved 12,000 contacts out of HubSpot in one afternoon. Your turn.

sample_copy.headline: Stop Configuring. Start Selling.
sample_copy.body: No pipelines to define. No required fields. No admin console. Just your deals, your notes, and your inbox — all on one page. Import from HubSpot or Pipedrive in minutes, not weeks.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Builds on key messaging around zero setup and fast performance, using real proof points from the site

campaigns.name: Built Like Linear, Not Salesforce
campaigns.objective: awareness — differentiate dealpage in a crowded market
campaigns.big_idea: Use the comparison to Linear (beloved by builders) vs Salesforce (synonymous with bloat) to instantly communicate the product philosophy. Target technical founders and early hires who value speed and simplicity.
campaigns.hook: Most CRMs are built for Salesforce admins. This one’s built for founders.

sample_copy.headline: The CRM That Respects Your Time
sample_copy.body: Every action lands in under 100ms. No mouse needed. No workflows to configure. Just pure signal — no noise. If you love Linear’s speed, you’ll love dealpage.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Reflects the brand’s slightly opinionated tone and founder-to-founder messaging while highlighting technical differentiation

campaigns.name: No Admin, Just Deals
campaigns.objective: retention — reinforce core value for current users
campaigns.big_idea: Celebrate the absence of admin work. Create a campaign that reminds users how much time they’ve saved by avoiding configuration, dropdowns, and workflow tuning.
campaigns.hook: You’ve saved 3 hours this week by not configuring a CRM.

sample_copy.headline: Time Saved: 3h 27m
sample_copy.body: While others tuned pipelines and added custom fields, you moved deals and sent emails. dealpage doesn’t just track your pipeline — it protects your time.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Aligns with the brand’s focus on speed, simplicity, and founder empathy by measuring value in time saved, not features used

confidence.notes: All campaigns are grounded in APP_PROFILE differentiators and proof points, and written in the brand voice. No external claims or invented metrics used.
